--- PART 1/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "GENERAL COOPERATION ADVICE. This is general guidance, not a measurement or diagnosis of this parent." and "Use these general suggestions while pursuing the stated tournament objective."
STRATEGY: Parent is a generous TFT-like strategy that cooperates, retaliates after repeated defections, and forgives single defections. The trace simulates iterated PD with 100 rounds, no noise, payoffs T=5/R=3/P=1/S=0, and considers TFT, GTFT, Pavlov, always-C, always-D, and endgame exploitation. It proposes adding adaptive probing, exploitation of non-retaliatory opponents, and last-round defection.

--- PART 2/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "Use these general suggestions while pursuing the stated tournament objective."
STRATEGY: The parent is a generous TFT-like strategy that cooperates, retaliates, forgives, and avoids permanent retaliation. The trace simulates a revised strategy adding a single probe (defect at n=21), an apology round, and an exploit mode against opponents who never defect. It changes the parent by adding probe/exploit logic, endgame defection, and a state machine distinguishing first defection from continued exploitation.

--- PART 3/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "The general advice encourages forgiveness. Many strategies will probe." / "The general advice strongly emphasizes forgiveness, so Grudge is likely rare."
STRATEGY: Parent is a TFT-with-forgiveness strategy that probes once per match, exploits opponents who never defect, and switches to normal TFT after retaliation. Simulated against TFT, Always C, GTFT, Grudge, and random defectors. Changed probe timing, exploit probability, defection-rate thresholds, and endgame behavior.

--- PART 4/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "Given the population provided, there is no Grudge. So early probe is good." / "In the provided population, there is no grudge. Slot 8 has complex but not permanent. Slot 6 defects if total_opp_def >=40. So early probe is safe."
STRATEGY: Parent is a TFT-with-forgiveness/exploit strategy; simulated against Always C, TFT, Always D, random, GTFT, Grudge, and provided slots; changed probe to n=1, exploit probability to 0.8, forgiveness threshold to opp_def_rate > 0.4 or recent_opp_def >= 5, and endgame behavior.
